question.question: What are the consequences of a successful cross-site scripting attack?
reference_facts: A successful XSS attack can allow execution of unauthorized commands (arbitrary code) in the victim's browser.
It can allow unauthorized reading of data (confidentiality impact).
It can allow unauthorized modification of data (integrity impact).
